title: Include operator build inputs in the CapRover source archive

consumers.reason: Operator commands remain separate; no cutover executed by publishing code.
Clarifies source archive requirements and asynchronous CapRover confirmation.
Build tools remain typechecked by existing tooling configuration.
Historical consolidation review; operator source is now included in packaging.
Historical native-runtime review; backend remains opt-in.
Historical workflow review; verification gates unchanged.
Workflow safety regressions unchanged and included in full suite.
Include scripts in the tracked source archive so esbuild can resolve the operator entry points.
Builds the real git archive from workflow paths and verifies that every declared build entry point is present.
Server and separate operator entry points remain unchanged.
Records the packaging failure and validation of the corrected publication.

areas.evidence: Only deployment packaging changes; the previously validated frontend remains unchanged.
No routes, request bodies or handlers changed.
No migration execution, backend flag or data mutation; production keeps its current Directus backend.
No financial calculations or dashboard changes.
No notification or email changes or sends.
Release QA report documents packaging scope; signed documents and application reports unchanged.

No workflow permissions, credentials, application permissions or backend selection changed.
Original Directus data and backups preserved; packaging includes source files only, not fixtures or database copies.
Real archive regression passed; platform:verify passed with 598 tests, types, contracts and build. Exact staged scope reviewed separately from unrelated pending files.
